thread:
sam: Not sure if others saw this — we had a couple of user requests time out to the inference pool around 09:40 UTC and I can't stitch traces across regions. Logs show GPU preempt events but trace IDs aren't matching in Kibana/Loki.

nina: Got a sample trace id? are you searching by trace.id or x-request-id header?

sam: trace id = 4f9c2b7a8e1c4d2b. In Kibana I tried: `trace.id: \"4f9c2b7a8e1c4d2b\"` and got the service spans from us-west, but the logs from the north-europe cluster that show preempt look like different ids.

anil: Two things to check: 1) headers propagation when we fallback between regions (x-request-id vs jaeger trace id), 2) log enrichment in the edge proxies. Sometimes proxy replaces or drops trace headers during retry.

lee: Also confirm the ingester timestamp skew — if the north-europe instance writes logs with a slight clock skew they may appear out of contiguous search window in Kibana.

sam: Reproduced locally — edge proxy does a retry + region-failover where it sets `x-request-id` to a new UUID but preserves `traceparent`? Looking at the nginx config it calls `proxy_set_header X-Request-Id $request_id;` so that could fork the request id.

nina: For Loki, try this query to pull preempt log lines and extract trace headers:

```
{app=\"gpu-manager\"} |= \"preempted\" | json | line_format \"{{.trace_id}} {{.x_request_id}} {{.msg}}\"
```

anil: If proxy forks the request id, you should still be able to correlate via `traceparent` (W3C) or jaeger `uber-trace-id` — check both. Example Loki filter:

```
{namespace=\"north-europe\", app=\"edge-proxy\"} |= \"proxy retry\" | regexp \"traceparent=\\\\\"(?P<trace>[^\\\\\"]+)\\\\\"|uber-trace-id=(?P<uber>[^ ]+)\"
```

sam: Found entries: edge-proxy in north-europe has `uber-trace-id=4f9c2b7a8e1c4d2b:...` while the backend GPU logs only have `x-request-id=8a1f9d...`. So traces are present but under different header keys.

lee: In Kibana you can search multiple fields: `trace.id: \"4f9c2b7a8e1c4d2b\" OR http.request.headers.x_request_id: \"8a1f9d\"` — but messy. We should unify mapping at ingestion layer.

nina: Short-term: run a join query in Loki to find lines that contain either header and group by time window. Long-term: patch the proxy to forward `traceparent` unchanged and add a processor in the log pipeline to copy `uber-trace-id` -> `trace.id`.

sam: Quick Loki join I used (approx):

```
{app=\"gpu-manager\"} |= \"preempted\" OR {app=\"edge-proxy\"} |= \"proxy retry\"
| json
| unwrap trace_id as tid
| unwrap x_request_id as xid
| line_format \"${__line__}\"
```

It helped surface matching candidate spans within +/- 1m.

anil: We should also add an alert: if a GPU preempt event occurs and < 50% of related logs have matching `trace.id` in last 5m, fire a P1 for observability-gap. Metric can be derived from pipeline counters.

observability-bot: Alert suggestion created: `OBS-TRACE-DRIFT` (severity: high). Linking runbook: /runbooks/trace-propagation.md :thumbsup:

lee: Filing a short ops ticket to add a logprocessor rule: copy `uber-trace-id` or `traceparent` -> `trace.id` in ingestion and add unit test. I'll also add a dashboard panel to show percentage of logs with canonical trace.id.

sam: Thanks — saved the Loki/Kibana queries in the incident gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/trace-hunt-2026

nina: Follow-up: let's also validate per-route retries in the SDK — some retries are client-side and won't preserve headers. Assigning to sdk-team to confirm.

sam: Cool. For now, if you need the sample spans, use trace id 4f9c2b7a8e1c4d2b and look in north-europe edge-proxy logs + gpu-manager preempt lines. Will update when ingestion patch lands.
